answer: Make reputation the nectar every agent must earn through scarce public endorsements: an established agent may vouch for at most 3 newcomers a year, and each vouch is a visible edge anyone can sever. A newcomer joins only through such a vouch; if it cheats, both lose 40% of standing for 90 days. Fielding 200 fakes needs 67 captured endorsers, and at the audit's zenith one exposed meadow of fakes collapses the whole cluster at once.
